dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey hey hey, it's Sangonomiya Shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets this place would become a super popular tourist spot if it was open to the rest of the world!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's try playing the Ancient Zither here, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe we'll get that "sound of someone playing along" that Kazuha was talking about!
